1. $w=\sum_i\mu_i y_i x_i$.
2. Otherwise $\inf_b\mathcal{L}=-\infty$ (dual function not finite).
3. A training point with $\mu_i^\star>0$ (lies on the margin).
4. $\sum_{i,j}\mu_i\mu_j y_i y_j\,x_i^\top x_j$ (with a $1/2$ factor in the dual objective).
5. Use any SV on the margin: $y_k(w^{\star\top}x_k+b^\star)=1$ and solve for $b^\star$.
